_help: Shared defaults, read from next to the app. Don't put your own bills here: the app creates config.local.json inside the bills folder on first run (every bill found set to "monthly"), and its keys replace the same keys here.

"folder": the bills folder, relative to this file. "./" = the folder the app is in. Also accepts "../2026", an absolute path, or "~/...". config.local.json and the PDF (bills-overview.output.pdf) go there.
"bills": which months each bill is expected. Bills not listed (or null) are shown but never flagged.
A key also covers every bill that starts with it: "Meter 01" covers "Meter 01 Photo 1 Before" etc. The longest matching key wins.
